iar_ela_prof.label: IAR ELA proficiency (%)
iar_ela_prof.note: ISBE lowered proficiency cut scores in 2025 and did not re-score earlier years: not comparable across 2024-25.

iar_math_prof.label: IAR math proficiency (%)
iar_math_prof.note: ISBE lowered proficiency cut scores in 2025 and did not re-score earlier years: not comparable across 2024-25.

sat_ela_prof.label: SAT ELA proficiency (%)
sat_ela_prof.note: 2022-23 is derived as Level 3 % + Level 4 %. Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

sat_math_prof.label: SAT math proficiency (%)
sat_math_prof.note: 2022-23 is derived as Level 3 % + Level 4 %. Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

sat_ela_avg.label: SAT reading average score
sat_ela_avg.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

sat_math_avg.label: SAT math average score
sat_math_avg.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

act_ela_prof.label: ACT ELA proficiency, grade 11 (%)
act_ela_prof.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

act_math_prof.label: ACT math proficiency, grade 11 (%)
act_math_prof.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

act_ela_avg.label: ACT ELA average score, grade 11
act_ela_avg.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break. ISBE's 'ELA' column: ACT ELA composite vs English subscore unconfirmed.

act_math_avg.label: ACT math average score, grade 11
act_math_avg.note: Grade 11 state test: SAT through SY2023-24, ACT from SY2024-25 with new cut scores. Never compare across the break.

act_ela_growth.label: ACT ELA growth percentile, grade 11
act_ela_growth.note: 2025 only; method across the PSAT10-to-ACT change unconfirmed.

g11_ela_gap.label: Grade 11 ELA score vs ACT benchmark (points, estimate)
g11_ela_gap.note: Average score minus ACT's national College Readiness Benchmark, in points (ELA 20, math 22). SAT years are ESTIMATES: school mean SAT scores converted with the official 2018 ACT-SAT concordance (ERW -> English+Reading / 2; SAT Math -> ACT Math). Comparable across years as an estimate; it is not a share of students.

g11_math_gap.label: Grade 11 math score vs ACT benchmark (points, estimate)
g11_math_gap.note: Average score minus ACT's national College Readiness Benchmark, in points (ELA 20, math 22). SAT years are ESTIMATES: school mean SAT scores converted with the official 2018 ACT-SAT concordance (ERW -> English+Reading / 2; SAT Math -> ACT Math). Comparable across years as an estimate; it is not a share of students.

flags.budget_k12_shared: The CPS budget unit covers both Catalyst Maria campuses (K-12); per-pupil uses their combined enrollment.
flags.isbe_predecessor_charter: State figures describe the charter that closed, not today's district-run school.
flags.isbe_predecessor_contract: State figures describe the contract-era school.
flags.isbe_partial_campus: State figures cover only part of today's combined school.
flags.isbe_k12_shared: State figures cover the K-12 school, including Catalyst Maria HS.
flags.no_separate_state_data: The state reports this school under 400115; no separate state data.
flags.isbe_match_by_address: State record matched by campus address; confirm.
flags.coords_from_predecessor: Coordinates carried over from the predecessor charter at the same site.
flags.history_from_predecessor: Earlier-year enrollment and demographics come from the predecessor charter ID.
flags.low_n: Fewer than 30 students: percentages swing on a handful of students.
flags.budget_pp_outlier: CPS budget per pupil is unusually low or high (small or specialised program).
flags.budget_not_comparable: Charter, contract, ALOP and SAFE budgets are not comparable to district-run schools.
flags.budget_zero_unit: The CPS budget unit for this school shows $0; shown as no data.
flags.ppe_outlier: ISBE per-pupil expenditure is a statistical outlier for Chicago schools.
flags.community_area_mismatch: CPS community area differs from the area containing the coordinates.
